request.brief: Rhine-Ruhr Mills, Germany's pre-WW1 civilian industrial expansion. The focus adds civilian factory capacity in the Ruhr. Single compact side-on cluster of three broad rolling-mill rollers with one short bright steel billet passing through, dark old cast-iron industrial forms, circa 1910, no modern CNC or robotics. Make it a bold relief, not tiny factory scenery. A complete smooth muted slate-blue shield with a tall simple peaked top, crisp beveled gunmetal rim and narrow brass lip; restrained ivory highlights and deep clean black shadows. Contemporary vanilla Paradox focus rendering, smooth sculpted surfaces and sharply cut edges, no rust, mottled paint, noisy grain, smoke clouds or scenery. Main rollers fill most of the frame, opaque backing behind them, clear outside margin and true exterior alpha, readable at 100×88. No text, numerals, maps, flags, insignia or overlay badges.

prompt.text:
Create one Hearts of Iron IV national focus icon: Rhine-Ruhr Mills, Germany's pre-WW1 civilian industrial expansion. The focus adds civilian factory capacity in the Ruhr. Single compact side-on cluster of three broad rolling-mill rollers with one short bright steel billet passing through, dark old cast-iron industrial forms, circa 1910, no modern CNC or robotics. Make it a bold relief, not tiny factory scenery. A complete smooth muted slate-blue shield with a tall simple peaked top, crisp beveled gunmetal rim and narrow brass lip; restrained ivory highlights and deep clean black shadows. Contemporary vanilla Paradox focus rendering, smooth sculpted surfaces and sharply cut edges, no rust, mottled paint, noisy grain, smoke clouds or scenery. Main rollers fill most of the frame, opaque backing behind them, clear outside margin and true exterior alpha, readable at 100×88. No text, numerals, maps, flags, insignia or overlay badges.

Requirements:
- Take the frame, outline and overall form from the style anchor images, not from a fixed family form; the size, transparency, margin and readability requirements here still apply.
- Flags and ribbons use invented colours, never a real country's flag, unless the brief names that country.
- The subject is large: it fills most of the emblem and may overlap its frame, never a small figure inside a wide empty plaque.
- A strong central symbol that supports the focus's story, readable contrast at 100x88 pixels.
- Real transparent background around the emblem: no backdrop behind it.
- Leave a small empty margin around the emblem.

Reference images, in the order attached:
1. style anchor: match its painting style, palette and level of detail
The style anchor images were chosen for this image. Match their form, framing, materials and palette; the vanilla form described under Requirements applies only where they do not show one.

Avoid: text; letters or numbers; watermark or signature; a drawn checkerboard pattern; a square backdrop behind the subject.

Produce exactly one image.
negative: a square backdrop behind the subject

Up to 4 images are sent: a pinned style as ordered; otherwise nation-specific files are left out unless the brief names the country, about half the slots are drawn from the files whose names best match the brief's words and themes and the rest from the family's most style-typical generic files, all seeded by a hash of the family, asset and brief
